ItemID: NA; Title: Exile On Main Street Remastered; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The bluesy rock fits my Clapton and Hendrix listening, but I would pass on a remaster today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wanted The Outlaws 1976-1996 20th Anniversary; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An outlaw country collection is not what I am looking for right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Beatles Live Hollywood Bowl; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic rock appeals to me, but I am less interested in a live release today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Chicago Only The Beginning; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar classic rock is appealing, but this collection does not give me a strong reason to choose it now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blackstar; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more in the mood for straightforward rootsy rock than Bowie's experimental side.
ItemID: NA; Title: Retrospective; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this fits my interests well enough to engage.
ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Jackson Browne's songwriting fits my recent interest in seasoned artists releasing reflective rock albums; this is my pick today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sticky Fingers; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its blues and roots rock fit my taste, but I would choose the Browne album this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Corazon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Santana's guitar playing interests me given my Clapton and Hendrix listening, but I am not drawn enough to choose this today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Donovan's Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for a folk-pop hits collection right now.
